_comment: 26.1.0-rc.11 is Windows only and fixes the rc.10 update dialog, whose Download & Install button was laid out past the window edge and so could not be clicked. The installer is self-signed (real Authenticode signature + timestamp; untrusted self-signed chain, so SmartScreen still warns). release_url/notes_url point at a PUBLIC notes page on this host, not at the GitHub release: the app repo is private, so a release URL 404s for every tester and for anyone signed out. No macOS entry yet; Kevin adds the macos platform block when a DMG is built. Mac testers stay on the still-hosted rc.2 DMG until then.
